objective: Screen four bear-regime gates on the live S3 book (BG01 QQQ<SMA200, BG02 SMH<SMA200, BG03 HYG/IEF ratio<SMA100, BG04 unscaled S3 equity curve<SMA200), each against a BG00 no-gate reference, a bisected exposure-matched control (EM-k) and a 20-offset circular-shift placebo (CS-k), for whether moving S3's risk weight to SHY while the gate is on cuts the pre-window (2016-2023) drawdown by more than an exposure-matched lower volatility target would, without breaking the frozen anchor-window return bar.

holdout_2026: already spent on the live S3 book; no holdout claim made here

exposure_matched_em_k.description: One control per gate (EM01..EM04): S3 with both the base (0.40) and boost (0.60) volatility targets scaled by a single factor c in (0, 1], found by bisection on the design window only, so that EM-k's mean daily gross risk exposure (sum of non-cash weights after the multiplier) equals gate k's mean daily gross risk exposure over the design window. No gate signal; continuously scaled. Not counted as a candidate.

circular_shift_cs_k.description: 20 placebos per gate (CS-k-1..CS-k-20): gate k's own design-window daily on/off series, circularly shifted by offset_j = round(N * j / 21) sessions for j = 1..20, where N is the number of design-window sessions. Preserves the gate's on/off durations and total time-in-market but breaks its alignment with actual market states. Evaluated on the design window only. Not counted as candidates.

fixed_simulation_budget.description: 4 gates (BG01-BG04) + 4 EM-k controls + 80 CS-k placebos = 88 simulations, fixed. BG00 requires no new simulation: its design-window numbers are reused from reports/paper/renewal/2026-09-23-s3-stress-2016-2023.json and its anchor-window numbers from the authorized 2026-09-23 S1-S3 renewal record.

design_window: (a) max drawdown improves by >= 10 percentage points vs BG00
(d) Sharpe beats >= 18 of its 20 CS-k placebos
anchor_window_do_no_harm: (e) at both 10 and 20 bp: CAGR >= 50% and max drawdown >= -35% (frozen gate G1)
adoption_rule.multiple_comparisons: 4 gates; report all regardless of outcome
